build_pipeline_text2image: build a text-to-image pipeline from a Hugging Face model name or single-file checkpoint URL
build_pipeline_image2image: build an image-to-image pipeline from a Hugging Face model name or Civitai model keyword
build_pipeline_inpainting: build an inpainting pipeline from a Hugging Face model name or single-file checkpoint URL
load_textual_inversion: load textual inversion embeddings into a pipeline's text encoder from Civitai search keywords
load_lora_weights: load LoRA weights into a pipeline's unet and text encoder from Civitai search keywords
